prompt: In a bustling anime style kitchen, chaos reigns supreme under the glare of overhead lights. On the far left, a chef in a tall white hat stands rigidly, gripping a silver ladle with determination. Next to him, a nervous apprentice in a blue apron trembles slightly while holding a stack of precarious plates. In the center foreground, a large copper pot bubbles violently on the stove, emitting thick steam that obscures the view slightly. To the right of the pot, a stern head chef with a thick black mustache points an accusatory finger at a spilled sauce on the floor. Near the back wall, a delivery person in a yellow helmet waits impatiently, tapping their foot against the tiled ground. A small gray cat sits calmly on top of a wooden crate in the corner, observing the frenzy with detached curiosity. Beside the cat, a rusty metal clock hangs crookedly on the wall, its hands frozen in time. In the mid-ground, a waitress in a pink uniform looks at the head chef with wide, worried eyes. She is handing a ticket to a line cook in a green bandana who is chopping vegetables with rapid precision. Behind them, a towering stack of dirty dishes leans dangerously close to falling over. The air is thick with tension and culinary urgency. There is no window visible in the background walls. There is no sunlight streaming into the room.
